WITH filtered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, o.amount, d.A3 as region
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE o.amount > 2802
),
group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id, 
    region, 
    AVG(amount) as group_avg
  FROM filtered_orders
  GROUP BY account_id, region
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_average
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT 
  g.account_id,
  g.region,
  g.group_avg,
  g.group_avg - o.overall_average as difference
FROM group_averages g
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE g.group_avg > o.overall_average
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
